R6L-moose-backcountry-0004.name: 260 m NW of Bell-Irving River
R6L-moose-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6L-moose-backcountry-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 2 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 9.8 ha, 80 m E.
Moose winter range u-6-018 unit 17 (official), right here. Counts from November.

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1. Parts closed or LEH only (Maps F25, F39, F40)
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 108 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.80076, -129.69026, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 121 m, about 119 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m NW of the spot at 675 m (56.83722, -129.63311). Water: unnamed wetland 200 m E (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-17, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6L-moose-backcountry-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-17: about 723 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.07 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
